overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board's unnoticed discussion of removing its chair at the September 14, 2017 meeting was not reasonably anticipated 48 hours in advance. No orders issued.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board discussed and voted on reorganizing the Board at its September 14 meeting, a topic not listed on the notice.
allegations.key_passage: we find the discussion at the September 14 meeting to be unexpected and a result of the dissatisfaction with the progression of the meeting.
